text: ぼくの　とりポケが　きみたちと　たたかい　たがってる！

structure.jp: ぼくの　とりポケが
たたかい　たがってる！

patterns.name: 〜たがる
patterns.span: たたかい　たがってる
patterns.explanation: たがる says that someone other than you shows signs of wanting to do something. たがってる is the short spoken form of たがっている. たたかい　たがってる = 'they are eager to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.explanation: と here means 'with' and shows who the battle is against. きみたちと　たたかう = 'battle with you guys'.
